mintAuthority.summary: MoonPay issuance uses a mutable IssuerGateway, while the earner manager can mint rewards directly to any account. The same issuer address controls token roles, rewards and ProxyAdmin on all four catalogued chains. A 300-second gateway delay does not constrain the reward or upgrade paths. An additional 0G native deployment has zero supply at block46024355 and is evidenced but not registered.

review.evidence: Independent 2026-10-03 RPC census at Ethereum 26110185, Arbitrum 511230133 and Monad 110115415: complete token RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history from block zero returned 17 events per chain; applying grants and revokes leaves sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and RATE_LIMIT_MANAGER_ROLE=0x314160525f5ea6677d3908112ff9bd885f3bb78e and exactly two ISSUER_ROLE members, IssuerGateway 0x693cc3305342b02ac1549b509a704ff944cd9499 and Portal 0xaad1466fe33d373189fb9dcc47270e608feee8a7. earnerManager() and token ProxyAdmin.owner() independently return the issuer address on each chain. EIP-1967 implementations resolve respectively to 0x0568d0a74145fd557b3541897bc6878f5c6e9c8c, 0x8dfb7c8ce5e67ace965520b134b4aca8fd71c5e0 and 0x411d482be645a807823bcc5f4e762d9c24c6966a; the structured upgrade inventory now covers all three exact deployments. Gateway delay remains distinct from reward and upgrade issuance. Financial reserve reconciliation and issuer key-custody safeguards are not established by this complete on-chain role census. W1R50 supervision research on 2026-10-03: PYUSDx terms section 13 expressly state that issuance is not regulated and regulatory protections applicable to regulated stablecoins are unavailable. MoonPay Enterprise likewise says PYUSDx is not a regulated stablecoin. The BVI issuer is MoonPay Digital Assets Limited, not the separately licensed UK/US/EEA/Jersey entities in MoonPay's licence roster; Paxos supervision is not supervision of this local issuance.
